patterns.recommendation: Identify the owning process and intended listener; do not terminate unknown production processes automatically.
Inspect ownership, ACLs and service identity; do not relax permissions recursively.

match_any: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
patterns.recommendation: Verify hostname, trusted chain and system clock. Never disable TLS verification as a repair.
Measure usage and identify approved cache/log candidates; preserve audit logs and user data.
Check resolver health, DNS record and network policy; do not bypass network controls.
Stop installation and verify publisher signatures and pinned versions before retrying.
Review measured resource use and bounded workload settings.
Check TLS compatibility, clock, SNI and certificates; do not fall back to clear text off loopback.
Check service health, pool use and routing; do not expose database credentials.
De-energize equipment and consult exact ratings and qualified electrical personnel.

guardrails: Patterns are triage, not root-cause proof.
Never execute repair solely from a phrase match.
Preserve backups, signatures and audit records.
